integrity: Analytical proof supplied and same-model checked; independent validation has not been performed. Standard central limit and Poisson theorems are explicitly used, not re-proved.
scientific_limitations: No uniform approximation rate, no global maximum size claim, no statement at critical-atom ties, no power improvement, and no claim of uniqueness beyond searched sources. Exact conditional composition counting is classical.
title: Two geometric boundary Poisson laws and exact conditional calibration for a zero-frequency goodness-of-fit test
